cleaner.label: Android (SDK and Android Studio)
cleaner.description: Cache, SDK temporary files, and Android Studio cache and logs. Does not touch emulators, signing keys, adb keys, local history or projects.

option.label: Android tools cache
option.description: Removes the cache folder inside .android (package lists downloaded by the SDK Manager). Does not touch debug.keystore, adbkey or the emulators.
option.warning: Recreated the next time the SDK Manager opens.

option.label: SDK Manager temporary files
option.description: Removes .temp and .downloadIntermediates inside the SDK folder: leftovers from package downloads and installs.
option.warning: Do not clean while the SDK Manager is downloading or installing a package.

option.label: Android Studio cache
option.description: Removes the caches folders of every Android Studio version. Does not touch local history (LocalHistory), settings or plugins.
option.warning: Close Android Studio. It reindexes the projects on reopen, which is slow.

option.label: Android Studio logs
option.description: Removes the log folder of every Android Studio version.
